description: Run an axe-core accessibility audit of a web page on one device and return the WCAG violations with their impact, the affected elements and how to fix them.

device.description: Device id, name or size; defaults to an iPhone

url.description: Page to load: a full URL, a bare host such as example.com, localhost:3000 for a local dev server, or a path to an HTML file

name: audit_accessibility
